prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with whiplash after a rear-end collision. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1414; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- It is not yet clear whether the injury came from this crash.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- The patient was treated for the same body area within the last two years, and that condition adds to the current complaints.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text:
Treatment Summary

The patient presented after a rear-end motor vehicle collision with neck pain and stiffness consistent with whiplash-type injury. Over the course of care, the patient attended 21 visits, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and soft tissue treatment. The course followed a typical pattern, with visit frequency tapering as symptoms gradually improved.

Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the presence of a cervical soft tissue injury. Whether this specific collision caused the injury, however, is not yet clear from the available records. The patient also received treatment for the same body region within the past two years, and that prior condition appears to contribute to the current complaints.

Billing records reflect the services rendered, with no repeated charges for the same services on the same dates. Ongoing monitoring is recommended, and the patient will be reassessed if symptoms change or new concerns arise.
